description: First named aerosol presets for atmosphere-reference sunset comparisons. Values are intentionally compact clear-sky scenario parameters, not global climatology.

sources.citation: A. K. Angstrom, On the Atmospheric Transmission of Sun Radiation and on Dust in the Air, Geografiska Annaler 11, 156-166, 1929.
sources.role: Power-law wavelength dependence of aerosol optical depth.

sources.citation: Holben et al. 1998, AERONET - A federated instrument network and data archive for aerosol characterization, Remote Sensing of Environment 66, 1-16.
sources.role: AERONET measures aerosol optical depth and inversion products such as single-scattering albedo and phase-function properties across aerosol regimes.

sources.citation: Dubovik and King 2000, A flexible inversion algorithm for retrieval of aerosol optical properties from Sun and sky radiance measurements, JGR 105, 20673-20696.
sources.role: AERONET inversion precedent for single-scattering albedo and phase-function retrievals.

sources.citation: Gueymard, SMARTS clear-sky spectral irradiance model and ASTM G-173 reference-spectrum configuration.
sources.role: Clear-sky spectral model precedent using selectable aerosol scenarios and explicit atmospheric conditions.

model.verticalDistribution: betaExt(lambda, altitude) = tau(lambda) / scaleHeightKm * exp(-altitudeKm / scaleHeightKm)
model.phase: single Henyey-Greenstein asymmetry parameter g per preset

presets.label: Rayleigh only aerosol control
presets.selectionRationale: Control case for isolating molecular Rayleigh and ozone effects.

presets.label: Preview earth-like aerosol
presets.selectionRationale: Preserves the previous hardcoded sky-patch aerosol behavior as a named control.

presets.label: Clear maritime
presets.selectionRationale: Low-AOD, weak wavelength slope, high single-scattering albedo preset for larger maritime particles.

presets.label: Clear maritime low AOD sensitivity
presets.selectionRationale: Diagnostic sensitivity variant that halves clear-maritime AOD while holding wavelength slope, SSA, scale height, and phase g fixed.

presets.label: Clear maritime lower-g sensitivity
presets.selectionRationale: Diagnostic sensitivity variant that reduces clear-maritime forward scattering while holding AOD, wavelength slope, SSA, and scale height fixed.

presets.label: Clear maritime higher-g sensitivity
presets.selectionRationale: Diagnostic sensitivity variant that increases clear-maritime forward scattering while holding AOD, wavelength slope, SSA, and scale height fixed.

presets.label: Clear maritime shallow aerosol sensitivity
presets.selectionRationale: Diagnostic sensitivity variant that compresses clear-maritime aerosol closer to the surface while preserving vertical AOD.

presets.label: Clear maritime deep aerosol sensitivity
presets.selectionRationale: Diagnostic sensitivity variant that spreads clear-maritime aerosol higher while preserving vertical AOD.

presets.label: Clear continental
presets.selectionRationale: Moderate clear-air continental preset with smaller particles and modest absorption.

presets.label: Hazy continental
presets.selectionRationale: Higher-AOD, more absorbing continental haze preset for sunset sensitivity tests.

notes: These presets are chosen as first comparison handles, not as universal climatological truth.
The reference runner remains single-scattering; multiple scattering from heavy haze is not yet modeled.
